prompt: An IR shows a very broad O–H band (2500–3300 cm⁻¹) overlapping with C–H, plus a C=O at 1710 cm⁻¹. The functional group is:

options.label: Carboxylic acid — very broad dimer O-H + C=O at 1710
An alcohol with a separate ketone — broad O-H + ketone C=O
A primary amide — N-H bands broaden with H-bonding, amide C=O at 1710
An ester with an acidic α-H — enolized form shows O-H + C=O

explanation: The hallmark of a carboxylic acid is the EXTRAORDINARILY broad O-H (2500–3300) from H-bonded cyclic dimers, overlapping with the C-H region. Alcohols have a narrower O-H (3200–3550). Amide C=O is ~1660, not 1710. Esters normally aren't enolized under IR conditions.
